text:
anna: Quick sync 7 launching adaptive-quantization (aq-v1) behind a flag. This is customer-requested to save token-costs for high-volume workloads. Need rollout safety plan + acceptance criteria.

tom: Thanks. Proposal: start with 1% tenant-slice (random tenant-sampling), smoke for 30m, then 5% global traffic, then 20% if green. Must enumerate exact abort conditions.

li: Abort signals (prod): token-cost reduction < 10% (fail to meet promise), generation quality regression on benchmark set > 2% measured by BLEU/embedding-sim, or customer error reports > 0.5% of treated traffic.

jo: Infra signals: GPU memory OOM spikes, model load failures, or queuing latency > baseline + 40% sustained for 10m. If infra trips, immediate rollback to fp16 variant and scale down.

marc: Customer-scoped gating: we should exclude tier-1 customers from early slices unless they opt-in. For tenants opted-in, have a per-tenant circuit enabled so we can roll back only those tenants.

priya: Implementation detail 7 controller supports scope: tenant|region|global. Default slice is tenant-randomized sampling with opt-out list for enterprise accounts. We'll implement a per-tenant flag override: `flags/aq-v1?tenant_id=XXX`.

anna: Good. How do we detect silent quality drifts that customers may not notice immediately? Set up regular eval runs against golden prompts (n=200) every 5m on treated traffic and compute token-level perplexity delta + embedding similarity.

li: Add a watch for hallucination patterns on critical intents (billing, auth). If hallucination rate > 0.1% on critical intents, auto-rollback that tenant.

tom: Automation rule suggestion: require either (A) any infra_critical signal OR (B) >=2 production signals in a rolling 10m window to trigger auto-rollback. Also include a hysteresis: once rolled back, mark tenant as quarantined for 24h and require manual resume.

marc: Need auditability: every automated action must create an incident record with metrics snapshot, flagged tenants, and the commit hash of the serving binary + model-variant. Store payload in S3 + metadata row in rollout_events DB.

priya: We'll extend rollout-controller API to accept `resume_policy` and `quarantine_period`. Example config snippet:
```json
{
  "feature": "aq-v1",
  "slices": ["1% tenants", "5% traffic", "20% traffic"],
  "auto_rollback": {
    "rules": [
      {"type": "infra_critical", "min_signals": 1},
      {"type": "prod_anomaly", "min_signals": 2, "window_s": 600}
    ]
  },
  "quarantine_period_h": 24
}
```

li: For A/B metrics: track cost-per-token, mean response latency, top-1/content similarity score, and error report rate. Use experiment id: `aq_v1_treatment`. Need dashboards per-tenant and aggregated.

jo: QA plan: on each stage run: run latency smoke (100 synthetic queries), fidelity suite (200 golden prompts), and critical-intent audits (50 examples). All must pass with no regression beyond thresholds.

anna: Launch-day staffing: engineering on-call for first 6 hours, product + solutions for customer comms, support standby for enterprise opt-ins. Prepare a short comms template explaining expected cost savings and opt-out steps.

marc: For partial-region issues, controller should support region-only rollbacks. If EU fails but APAC/US healthy, only disable aq-v1 in EU. Escalate to global only if >1 region fails within 15m.

priya: Add model-variant fallback: if latency > baseline + 50% for >2m route to `aq_v1_safe` (a slower, more conservative quant profile) before full rollback. That gives us a graceful degradation path.

li: Also watch for drift in tokenization differences that change billing. If billed tokens deviate unexpectedly, pause to avoid customer billing surprises.

tom: Safety knobs: - warm-up window per tenant (traffic ramp to assigned slice over 10m) - cooldown between ramps (5m) - backoff multiplier for repeated rollbacks (x3, x6, etc.).

jo: We'll need runbook steps: 1) triage signals 2) confirm on dashboards 3) invoke `/flags rollback aq-v1 --scope tenant|region|global` 4) populate incident template and notify customers if impacted 5) schedule a postmortem if rollback impacted >5% traffic or enterprise tenant.

anna: Who owns what? Priya: infra alarms + controller API. Marc: opt-in tenant list and comms. Li: quality evals and golden set. Jo: QA scripts. Tom: rollout playbook + A/B dashboards. I'll coordinate the PR.

marc: One more ask from sales: a per-customer toggling UI in console so account teams can flip aq-v1 for their customers. This must be audited.

priya: We can add an audited toggle (console + API) that writes to rollout_events with actor info.

infra-bot: Scheduled dry-run: `aq-v1` 1% tenant-sample -> 2026-05-11T09:00Z (dry-run). :white_check_mark:

anna: Ok everyone 7 please ack with a single line if you can deliver your item before the dry-run. I'll publish the playbook and open the feature flag PR afterwards.

tom: Ack - dashboards by EOD.

li: Ack - golden set + evals ready.

jo: Ack - QA scripts by tomorrow morning.

marc: Ack - comms + tenant list ready.

priya: Ack - alerts and controller endpoints live in staging.

anna: Thanks! I'll post the playbook link when PR is up.)
